method: Read-only inspection of UE4 binary .umap/.uasset name tables (package paths are stored as plain strings), plus LargeMapManager.cpp source.
headline: A Town11 tile umap is the positive control and it REFERENCES /Game/Carla/Static/Terrain/Town11/<mesh>. That confirms Static/Terrain/<MapName>/ is the authoritative mesh location and FIX_A (move meshes beside the umap) is definitively wrong. FIX_B-prime (point references at Static/Terrain) is the correct direction.

positive_control_town11.conclusion: A tile streaming level references its meshes from Static/Terrain/<MapName>/, NOT from the map folder. Ingolstadt's meshes are already in exactly that canonical place.

ingolstadt_current_state.size_sanity: 25828 bytes cannot hold a 5711-entry name table (>=325527 bytes needed), so Ingolstadt.umap provably does NOT contain the 5711 building references.

revised_diagnosis_of_the_5711.previous_claim: The persisted tile map serializes 5711 wrong references.
revised_diagnosis_of_the_5711.correction: NOT SUPPORTED by the persisted artifacts. Ingolstadt.umap contains zero Ingolstadt_Tile_X_Y_ references, and no tile .umap exists. The 5711 'Failed to find object' messages therefore cannot have come from a saved Ingolstadt tile map.
revised_diagnosis_of_the_5711.most_likely_explanation: They were emitted from IN-FLIGHT tile scenes created by the FBX import (bConvertScene=1) during the interrupted run. The mesh packages were written to Static/Terrain/Ingolstadt at 16:39-16:40, while the tile scenes' references still used the import destination /Game/Ingolstadt/Maps/Ingolstadt, and the .umap saves never completed because the run was externally interrupted at 17:03:54.
revised_diagnosis_of_the_5711.status: HYPOTHESIS - requires a clean completed import to confirm
revised_diagnosis_of_the_5711.implication_if_true: The namespace defect may be an artifact of the interrupted run rather than a standing pipeline defect. That must be established before any fix is applied, otherwise a correct pipeline could be 'fixed' into a wrong state.
revised_diagnosis_of_the_5711.alternative_explanation_not_excluded: A previous generation left references in some asset not searched here.
revised_diagnosis_of_the_5711.how_to_settle: Run one clean import of a SINGLE small tile to completion and inspect whether (a) the tile umap is written to Maps/Ingolstadt and (b) its references point at Static/Terrain/Ingolstadt or Maps/Ingolstadt. That single experiment discriminates the two explanations.

why_GenerateMap_found_zero_tiles.mechanism: Loads UWorld assets from InAssetsPath and keeps only names containing '_Tile_', then LoadCarlaMapTile(...) each as a streaming level.
why_GenerateMap_found_zero_tiles.explanation: Ingolstadt has zero *_Tile_*.umap assets, so the large map has no tile streaming levels at all. This is fully explained and is a direct consequence of the tile .umap files never being saved.
why_GenerateMap_found_zero_tiles.downstream_effect: A LargeMap with no tiles renders no Ingolstadt geometry, regardless of whether the 5711 references resolve.

Map:EmptyMap.explanation: Each Town11_Tile_* package hosts an EmptyMap world object and a Default__ object. Because 132 tile packages all expose EmptyMap as their primary asset, UE4 computes the same PrimaryAssetID Map:EmptyMap for all of them and reports 775 duplicates.
Map:EmptyMap.classification: STRUCTURAL_CARLA_BEHAVIOUR - each tile is a scene variant sharing one template world package

Map:LargeMap.evidence: Ingolstadt.umap references /Game/Carla/Maps/BaseLargeMap/LargeMap.Ingolstadt; the log's duplicate warning pairs /Game/Carla/Maps/BaseLargeMap/LargeMap against /Game/Maps/BaseLargeMap/LargeMap
Map:LargeMap.explanation: Content/Carla/Maps is a junction to Content/Maps, so the same physical LargeMap is reachable as both /Game/Carla/Maps/... and /Game/Maps/.... UE4 Map PrimaryAssetID is Map:<AssetName>, which ignores path, so the alias alone produces the duplicate.
Map:LargeMap.note: Also establishes that Ingolstadt is registered as a streaming level INSIDE LargeMap, not as an independent map.

fix_direction_now_confirmed.FIX_A_move_meshes_beside_umap: REJECTED - contradicts the Town11 positive control and would duplicate 72 MB out of the canonical location
fix_direction_now_confirmed.FIX_B_prime_point_references_at_Static_T: CORRECT DIRECTION - matches how Town11 tile umaps reference their meshes
fix_direction_now_confirmed.blocking_question: Whether the reference path is produced by the FBX scene import (in which case import settings are wrong) or by a later relink step that never ran because the import was interrupted.
fix_direction_now_confirmed.single_tile_experiment_needed: One clean, completed, single-tile import answers this and must precede any bulk fix.

live_cook_constraint_respected.actions_taken: read-only file reads and source inspection only
